title: Treaty articles between Siena and the imperial side, subscribed by Niccolo Ziegler, 1510s-1520s (ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 18, DECODE R4806)

documents.shelfmark: ASSi, Concistoro 2308, fasc. 2 "Lettere in cifra", no. 18 (DECODE R4806)

transcription.notes: year unknown, 1510s-20s (Ziegler, Ponte a Valiano); 1515 placeholder; token count from the prep script

system.summary: Latin simple substitution on 30 signs for the sensitive words of a Latin text, words divided by points; dotted signs are nulls; a few signs for letter pairs (PHI = pp, HX = rr).
system.notes: Look-alike pairs separated on the image: hooked n = q, plain n = e; o = g, lead-in o = o; open OO = i, closed pair = ll. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): each letter of the bundle has its own key; this entry is no. 18 only.

prior_solution.where: Not in print or online (Meister 1902, Cecchini 1952, Senatore 2009 checked); the 1952 inventory calls the bundle 'solo parzialmente decifrate'

conditions.human_role: Set the goal (decipher the 29 letters; try the 42 filed keys first). Instructed that DECODE records marked Decrypted are to be trusted as read.

solution.what: Found the whole busta Concistoro 2308 on DECODE (keys R4746-R4789, letters R4790-R4814, R1858), missed by the 23 Sept scan; downloaded 131 images with the project cookie (the session that worked on all the Concistoro letters).
Viewed and indexed the 43 key records of fasc. 1 (R4746-R4789); compared their alphabets by eye with this letter's signs: none fits.
No. 18 transcribed (agent K) and re-verified on the images (agent L: 14 of about 1,450 tokens changed; transcripts/no18v.txt).
No. 18 (1,456 tokens, 211 point-divided Latin cipher words, 30 signs): homsolve2 words=1 with the Latin LM recovers the key unaided (Siena-Empire treaty articles, Ponte a Valiano, Florentines).
Split on 14 Oct 2026 from siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): each letter of the bundle has its own key; this entry is no. 18 only.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 1172 tokens, 32 types, la order 4: reading -2.464 per letter; random keys -5.005 (z 4.3); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.003 (mean -3.027, z 26.4); annealer on the real text -2.281. Verdict: underdetermined.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -1.967; polyphony 0.057; 298 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.281

outcome.method_basis: homsolve2 with word boundaries and a Latin model gave the key from the ciphertext alone; look-alike signs then separated on the images.
outcome.fraction_read_source: transcripts/no18_reading.txt counts: 1,271 of 1,459 cipher tokens read as sense (87.1%), 154 doubtful (10.6%), 21 unread (1.4%), 13 struck (0.9%).

gaps.item: doubtful and unread words (about 12% of 1,459 tokens)
gaps.detail: W/m/tt and dotted-null distinctions at the DECODE resolution

outcome.notes: Latin articles of a treaty between Siena and the imperial side, subscribed by Niccolo Ziegler, Regis Secretarius; 1510s-20s, year not fixed. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): each letter of the bundle has its own key; this entry is no. 18 only.
